messages:
zoe_pm: Quick convo: Verto asked for a compact Console page that ties route-level spend to SLO breaches and deploy annotations for their budgeting review. They want something safe to ship by end of Q2. Can we sketch MVP + acceptance?

mike_backend: Key constraints: per-route cost needs token counts + model price snapshot. Avoid heavy joins by tagging events at ingress with price_id. Also need a reliable route_id on every request.

rachel_ui: UX idea: single-pane with route selector, time window, small stacked cost chart (tokens vs price delta vs infra), SLO breach flags, and a drill-to-traces CTA. Keep export simple CSV/PDF.

hugo_sre: Operational rules: feature off by default per-org. Traces are on-demand only and count against a quota. Auto-disable trace fetch if any host CPU increases >2.5% after enabling. telemetry-bot: please create flag and alert.

telemetry-bot: Flag proposal: route_spend_beta. Alert: route_spend_ingest_cpu_delta threshold 2.5% -> notify #eng-oncall and #eng-platform. Runbook stub created.

zoe_pm: Acceptance criteria draft:
- Verto can select their top routes and see cost/day + error-rate/day for last 30 days
- SLO breach markers visible on timeline (click -> shows incident id and deploy sha)
- Clicking an error point triggers up to 5 on-demand traces (sanitized) and CSV export with: route_id,date,tokens_in,tokens_out,model_id,price_id,unit_price_usd,cost_usd,error_count,p95_ms
- Performance: Phase A (ingest tags + UI) must not increase p99 request latency by >1% median

mike_backend: Implementation plan (phases):
- Phase A: ingress tagging (route_id, model_id, tokens, price_id snapshot), aggregated cost + SLO markers in Console, CSV export
- Phase B: on-demand traces with org quotas and 30d TTL compressed storage
- Phase C: auto-correlation & routing suggestions (future)

rachel_ui: Small UX additions: add a "cost explain" micro-overlay that shows token delta vs model price change vs volume change when selecting a spike. Also a compact "procurement slide" export option.

ana_qe: QA acceptance tests I'll add:
- End-to-end: ingest synthetic requests for route X across 30 days, apply price snapshot mid-window, verify cost calculation matches expected formula
- SLO marker correctness: inject synthetic breach events and check timeline mapping
- Trace gating: request traces beyond org quota -> get clear error message

hugo_sre: Guardrails: per-org rate limits for trace fetches, anomaly detector: if total stored traces growth > expected baseline + 150% over 24h, auto-throttle and notify infra.

mike_backend: Cost formula we'll use: cost_usd = sum((tokens_in + tokens_out) * unit_price_at_ingest) + optional infra_surcharge. We'll keep surcharge out of default view and add toggle. Price snapshot at ingest to avoid retroactive joins.

zoe_pm: Data ownership + owners matrix:
- Product: zoe_pm (Verto contact + acceptance)
- Backend: mike_backend (ingest changes + price snapshot)
- UI: rachel_ui (cards + export + micro-overlay)
- SRE: hugo_sre (alerts + auto-disable + quota enforcement)
- QA: ana_qe (acceptance tests)

rachel_ui: Mockups ETA: 3 business days. Will include PDF export mock and tooltip copy for "cost explain".

mike_backend: Dev tasks: SDK flag to optionally send price_id, ingress annotator, small materialized view that aggregates cost per route/day for console queries. I'll open PRs this week.

ana_qe: I'll author test data generator + acceptance script. Will include a sample SQL to validate: SELECT route_id,date,sum(tokens)*unit_price as cost FROM materialized_route_cost WHERE org='verto' GROUP BY route_id,date;

hugo_sre: I'll draft runbook: steps to disable sampling, contact list, and an automated playbook if CPU delta >2.5% or storage cost breaching projected cap.

zoe_pm: Timeline check: if we freeze scope to Phase A (no traces stored), and Verto provides route list, can we beta in 5 weeks?

mike_backend: Yes for Phase A if we reprioritize a sprint. Phase B (on-demand traces) requires perf signoff and quota infra, likely Q3.

rachel_ui: I'll include the procurement-friendly export and short explanatory copy for finance decks in the mockups.

telemetry-bot: Reminder: record decision in roadmap doc: ship Phase A gated beta for Verto; Phase B targeted post-beta.

zoe_pm: Action items recap: @mike_backend ingress PR + materialized view, @rachel_ui mockups + export copy, @hugo_sre runbook + alerts, @ana_qe acceptance scripts, Verto -> route list. Will update ticket and follow-up next Wed.

mike_backend: One more note: log retention for price_id snapshots must be durable for reconciliation. We'll retain price metadata for 90 days.

zoe_pm: Great. Thanks team. Closing thread and will attach mockups once ready. :rocket:
